registryBasis: Rosreestr/NSPD are national cadastral references. The Irkutsk regional GISOGD geoportal was identified as a planning-information portal, but no city/local cadastral parcel service or usable anonymous parcel response was verified.

technicalBlocker: nspd.gov.ru and rosreestr.gov.ru timed out within bounded requests; geoportal.irkobl.ru failed TLS certificate verification. TLS was not disabled and no narrow exception was authorized.
